title: pissbox global configuration
description: Host-wide launcher configuration. Secrets are addressed by the sandbox environment variable that receives a proxy placeholder.

network.description: Additional network permissions for new sandboxes. Block rules take precedence over allow rules, including kit defaults.

allow.description: Patterns to allow in addition to the base kit permissions.

block.description: Patterns to deny, taking precedence over all kit allow rules.

vault.description: Shared host-only Markdown vaults, available to all bridge sessions. Keys are stable vault names.

secrets.description: Proxy-managed secrets applied to every new sandbox. Keys are environment variable names; values describe a host command that SBX runs to obtain the real value.

propertyNames.description: Environment variable name that receives a placeholder in the sandbox. PISSBOX_* and SANDBOX_NAME are reserved.

networkPatterns.description: SBX network patterns. Use one pattern per entry, without whitespace or comma-separated values. SBX validates supported pattern syntax.

vault.description: One host-only vault. Never mounted by the launcher.

path.description: Host directory, absolute or starting with ~/.

git.description: Automatically commit each changed note when this directory is a Git repository; defaults to true.

host.description: Host, IP address, or wildcard pattern that receives the credential, or a non-empty array of these. No scheme, port, or path.

command.description: Host command whose stdout SBX uses as the credential. The command must fetch the value, not embed it. The launcher probes it for availability before registration and passes it unchanged to SBX.
